name: Golden Horde Feudal Aggro
author: Eldritch

notes: Queue 2 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ batches and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@
Send 4 to @resource/sheep.webp@

Send 1 to build @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@ then @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ (near @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if front because you'll make @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ later on it) and then go @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Send 1 of the 2 new @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build @building_mongols/ger.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and mine
Keep 2 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@@resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up
Age-up with @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_building_carts_age2.webp@

Send 4 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ the next @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ batch to it as well, then @resource/rally.webp@ back to @resource/resource_food.webp@

As soon as you have 150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ build @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ with 1 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@
Try to have the @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ in the influence zone and space around for at least the first two military production buildings

Produce @unit_golden_horde/khan.webp@ from @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ and send to enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to harass, try to keep him alive, dodge @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@
From the free carts, build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and @building_military/stable.webp@ around @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ for 20% production speed increase
Send 1 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build @building_mongols/ger.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ the next @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ batch to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ then @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Produce 1 @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ batch and 1 @unit_mongols/keshik-2.webp@ batch as soon as possible and rally to the enemy base
Continue producing @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@
Produce @unit_golden_horde/torguud.webp@ as soon as you have 200 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ and rally to enemy base, heal @unit_golden_horde/khan.webp@ if necessary
Research @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@

Once 10 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 5 then 1 more to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ then @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_food.webp@
Send 1 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build second @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@
Continue producing @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ and try to deny enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or @resource/resource_food.webp@
Make more @unit_mongols/keshik-2.webp@ when your resources allow it
Whenever possible build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and research @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ and @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@
Research @technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@ if enemy goes 2 TC and you're in a safe position to push it with 2 rams

description: A Build Order to simply go aggro in Feudal, with Keshiks + Archers, either all-in or into Castle. Works best against booming/passive opponents.
